summary: Appeals arising from refusal to quash proceedings under 498A/506 IPC and Dowry Prohibition Act/DV Act; allegations of dowry harassment and domestic violence; High Court found prima facie case; appellants claimed vague unspecified allegations; application of Bhajan Lal principles; quashing appropriate only if allegations absurd, unmaintainable legally, or manifest abuse; case involves disputed facts and credibility requiring trial; no quashing warranted on face of materials.
legal_provisions_cited: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
final_judgment: Leave granted; appeals dismissed; High Court judgment upholding proceedings upheld; trial proceedings to continue.
